title: Local AI pre-screening for human triple-blind peer review in health sciences
abstract: arXiv:2608.14625v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Academic peer review is under mounting strain: NeurIPS 2025 received 21,575 submissions, ICLR 2025 received 11,603, and ICML 2025 received 12,107. This volume has outpaced the supply of qualified reviewers, and large language models (LLMs) are already filling the gap, largely undisclosed. An independent analysis of ICLR 2026 found roughly 21% of its 75,800 peer reviews were fully AI-generated, with over half showing some AI involvement (up from 15.8% in 2024). Documented risks include hallucinated citations in accepted papers and hidden prompt-injection instructions embedded in manuscripts to manipulate AI reviewers into favorable assessments.   We propose a triple-blind, multi-LLM pre-screening framework for peer review, developed for a health sciences journal, that formalizes and discloses AI involvement while preserving human reviewers as the final decision-making authority. translated_title: 健康科学领域人类三重盲审的本地AI预筛查
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14625v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：学术同行评审正面临日益严重的压力：NeurIPS 2025收到21,575篇投稿，ICLR 2025收到11,603篇，ICML 2025收到12,107篇。这一数量已超过合格审稿人的供应能力，大型语言模型（LLMs）正在填补这一缺口，但大多未公开披露。对ICLR 2026的独立分析发现，其75,800篇同行评审中约有21%完全由AI生成，超过一半显示出一定的AI参与（高于2024年的15.8%）。已记录的风险包括被接收论文中的虚构引用，以及嵌入稿件中的隐藏提示注入指令，用于操纵AI审稿人做出有利评估。我们提出一个三重盲审、多LLM预筛查框架，用于同行评审，该框架专为健康科学期刊开发，正式化并披露AI参与，同时保留人类审稿人作为最终决策权威。该框架将投稿路由通过五个阶段——s
tldr: 该论文提出一个三重盲审、多LLM预筛查框架，在健康科学期刊中正式化AI辅助评审流程，同时确保人类审稿人保留最终决策权，以应对学术评审数量激增和AI参与不透明的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a triple-blind, multi-LLM pre-screening framework for peer review in health sciences, formalizing AI assistance while keeping human reviewers as the final authority, addressing the surge in submissions and undisclosed AI involvement.
